introduction.objective: Name how many equal parts make one whole.

learningGoals.objective: Count the equal parts in a whole.

skills.description: Count the equal parts in a whole.

tutorGuidance: This is a small authoring starter, not a complete researched lesson. The whole bar is split into equal parts. A meaningful explanation connects the number of equal parts to the whole bar. A different number of parts provides another counting example. Assess only currentAttempt after Check, never the draft. Use the visible parts to address a counting error. Available practice varies the number of parts; do not describe a repeated or revealed answer as fresh independent evidence.
